files.description: One row per site: its published campaigns with the number of samples in each, the total, and the families measured. Start here for questions about a site: when, how often, what.
One row per sample: site, campaign, dates, temperature, the families and number of compounds measured. Whole file, for tools that run code.
One row per site, campaign and family: samples, compounds measured, results and detected results (sums not counted). Whole file, for tools that run code.
